200.description: The report for the effective range.

days.description: One row per UTC day intersecting the range, in day order, zeros included.

registered.description: Products registered in the day's window.

classified.description: Products whose first classification fell in the window.

dimensions_declared.description: Products whose first declared dimensions fell in the window.

measured.description: Products whose first measurement fell in the window.

open_discrepancies.description: Products whose latest physical profile at the window's end has a declared-vs-measured discrepancy.

coverage.description: The current state of every product the projection knows (not range-bound).

products.description: Distinct SKUs seen in any product event.

dimensions_declared.description: Products whose current physical profile has declared dimensions.

measured.description: Products whose current physical profile has a measurement.

classified_ratio.description: classified / products (0 when there are none).
